settings.name: Maya R.
settings.title: My shoulders stay calm after a hot shower now
settings.text: Winter used to mean red, tight patches across my shoulders. I wash with this, pat dry and put the lotion on straight away. It barely foams, which threw me at first. Now it's the only thing in my shower.

settings.name: Hannah K.
settings.title: No tight arms, no smell
settings.text: First wash that doesn't leave my arms tight. No smell at all, which is the whole point.

settings.name: Tom B.
settings.title: My shins stopped cracking
settings.text: Long shifts, hot showers and very dry legs. This is the first wash I don't have to follow with a heavy cream every night.

settings.name: Priya S.
settings.title: Gentle, rinses clean
settings.text: No sting and no film left on my skin. One star off because the pump gets stiff near the end of the bottle.

settings.name: Jules M.

settings.title: Bath time without the rough patches
settings.text: A small pump for our son's bath, then the lotion. The backs of his knees used to look rough by morning. They haven't for weeks.

settings.name: Ana L.
settings.title: On my fourth bottle
settings.text: Legs feel soft rather than squeaky after the shower. One bottle lasts me about ten weeks.

settings.name: Sam O.
settings.title: Fragrance-free really means it
settings.text: My partner likes the chamomile one and I can't use anything scented, so we keep both in the shower. This one smells of nothing at all.

settings.name: Rachel D.
settings.title: Early days, but no sting
settings.text: Too soon to say much. It doesn't sting the patches on my hands, which is more than most washes manage.

settings.name: Dev P.
settings.title: One bottle for two little ones
settings.text: Our two share it at bath time. No scent to put them off, and their skin isn't rough the next day.
A few things worth knowing before the bottle reaches your shower.

settings.question: Does fragrance-free mean it has no smell?
settings.answer: We add no perfume or essential oils to Calm wash. You may notice a faint scent from the ingredients themselves.

settings.question: Can I use it if I have an oat allergy?
settings.answer: Calm wash contains colloidal oat. Check the full ingredient list against your known allergies, and ask your healthcare professional if you are unsure.

settings.question: How is Rich wash different?
settings.answer: Rich wash has extra shea butter and oat oil, with a thicker, almost lotion-like feel. Calm wash is the everyday starting point.
settings.quick_line: Very dry or winter skin. Thicker, almost a lotion.
settings.quick_ing: Calm wash plus extra shea butter and oat oil. Fragrance-free. pH 5.5.

settings.question: What if my skin reacts?
settings.answer: Stop using it and contact us. We refund your first bottle, used or not. Read the skin-reaction refund details.
